别名

Yuri, a newly-wedded woman, started a new life in an apartment. Then, her husband had to go away on a business trip for 5 days. The night before his departure, they made love more passionately than usual. The next morning, she got a sudden visit of a young man, who was the son of the president of the management firm of her apartment. A story of dark desire towards Yuri started…

别名

One day, you casually rent a porn DVD. You start watching it, but then you can’t believe your own eyes as you look at the image on the screen.

あらすじ

You are going out with Sakuragi Sayaka, planning to have some fun with Sayaka during the forthcoming summer holidays. But Sayaka gives you the cold shoulder recently, turning down dates only saying “sorry, not today.” One day, one of your friend asks you to go to the broadcast room in the school.
